title: A GPU-resident Block Wiedemann GF(2) linear-algebra implementation - v1.0.1
description: A GPU-resident implementation of the Block Wiedemann algorithm for solving large sparse linear systems over GF(2). All three stages run on the GPU: Krylov sequence generation, Berlekamp-Massey (lingen), and solution reconstruction. The solver is built on a CUDA sparse matrix-matrix multiplication (SpMM) layer over GF(2) providing several kernel implementations with automatic tuning and format selection. It is used as the linear-algebra stage of the CUDA-MPQS quadratic sieve, and is also usable as a standalone library.
